review.reviewer: independent PH-300 project-close ADR reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: BLOCKER - the frozen close-state machine is not mapped to the merged Project model: ADR 0017 defines close object `active -> closing -> closed -> reopened`, but the delivered `core.Project` has only `stage in (initiation, planning, execution, acceptance, warranty, closed, on_hold, cancelled)` and `previous_stage`; there is no active/closing/reopened close status, and the ADR neither maps the target states to `Project.stage`/a new close record nor states the required model/status migration. The background correctly lists the delivered owners but the decision silently introduces an incompatible lifecycle. Fix: either (a) freeze the existing `Project.stage` semantics (e.g. execution/acceptance -> close preconditions, closed -> closed, on_hold/cancelled distinctions) with explicit transitions, or (b) keep the target close states but declare a canonical ProjectClose/status entity or Project.stage extension, old->new mapping, backfill and migration in PH-322's implementation prerequisites. The ADR must not present a new state enum as existing fact.

OTHER CONTENT CHECKED: the close precheck list covers contract/change (PH-275), settlement/OpenItem/clearance (PH-283), revenue pairing (PH-284), fee cost (PH-280), cash (PH-288), time/import (PH-269/274) and period (ADR 0016) with null+missing and owner-read references; open-item handling (clear via clearance/refund/return/owner commands, no direct edit), close-after write rejection/correction via negative reversal/撤核/撤转/重新开项, append-only conclusion, company lock/request_token/idempotency/repeat-close rejection, role matrix/history_read, and non-goals are stated. The ADR is docs-only, number 0017 (0016 reserved for period close), 6 changed files within the 8-path whitelist, no code/migration/schema/canonical topic; PH-300 in_review/handoff and PH-322 blocker now points to ADRs 0016/0017 and the remaining prerequisites. check ok=245; governance 23 OK; verify-change --base 15cf20c --task PH-300 only high_risk_review_required, no path_out_of_scope.
